newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes softer against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes softer against dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower against the dollar despite recovering ground lost due to import covering, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.77 to the dollar after opening at 57.75 and falling to 57.81, they said.
"The rupee fell to 57.81 briefly due to import covering, but recovered somewhat when the buyer moved out," said an American Express Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 9.87 percent after rising to a high of 10.25 percent, with the market well offered, dealers said.
